Lemma
[Hessian comparison at a contact point]

Source: petersen:page-0295, petersen:page-0296 1. ch7:7.1.5If $f,h:(M,g) o \mathbb {R}$ are $C^2$ functions such that $f(p)=h(p)$ and $f(x)\ge h(x)$ for all $x$ near $p$, then \[ abla f(p)= abla h(p),\qquad \Hess f|_p\ge \Hess h|_p,\qquad \Delta f(p)\ge \Delta h(p). \]
Proof

↗ lem:pet-ch7-hessian-touching-comparison \sketch Apply one-variable calculus to $f\circ c$ and $h\circ c$ for geodesics $c$ through $p$. Equality of values gives equality of differentials, and the second derivative inequality for every initial velocity gives $\Hess f|_p\ge \Hess h|_p$; tracing proves the Laplacian inequality.

□
